question: Which keyboard shortcut is used to make the selected text bold in MS Word 365?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ctrl + B**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Ctrl + B** is the shortcut used to make the selected text bold in Microsoft Word 365 and other versions.
 
• This shortcut enables users to quickly emphasize text by applying the bold formatting without navigating through menus.
 
• Bold formatting is commonly used to highlight important sections of text or headings within a document.
 
• In MS Word, users can toggle bold formatting on and off by using the **Ctrl + B** shortcut repeatedly.
 
• This shortcut works universally across Windows operating systems for Microsoft Word.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ctrl + I:** This shortcut is used to italicize the selected text in MS Word.
 
• **Ctrl + U:** This shortcut is used to underline the selected text in MS Word.
 
• **Formatting Basics:** Bold, italic, and underline are basic text formatting tools used to emphasize content in documents.
 
• **Ribbon Formatting:** Apart from keyboard shortcuts, users can apply these formats via the "Home" tab in the MS Word ribbon.
 
• **Cross-Platform Compatibility:** These shortcuts (Ctrl + B, Ctrl + I, Ctrl + U) are also functional in other Microsoft Office applications like Excel and PowerPoint.
